sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
Non-{{tip|basic damage}} dealt on the same target may apply stacks only once per frame.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
sources_quoted.note: {{rd|X|Y}} is the wiki melee/ranged-difference template; confirmed by cross-checking 25+ other items in data/items.json that use it (Tiamat/Ravenous Hydra 40% AD melee / 20% AD ranged, Titanic Hydra 1% / 0.5%, Phage 20 / 10 MS, etc.).

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 2.3 item 2 ("Where the composition is an approximation")
sources_quoted.quote: Black Cleaver average stacks (`ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction`): the established model uses a fixed `0.8*max_stacks` constant (with a `hits/2` short-fight branch). Under the engine's own ordering convention (4 leading ability hits apply stacks before the auto stream) the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C - C(C-1)/(2h)` for `h >= C`; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes. The stack duration (6 s) is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS*u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant - this is a documented tuning constant, not a theorem. Recommendation: replace the constant with the closed-form Cesaro mean when a champion module needs exact BC numbers (a candidate P3 item; changing it re-tunes every BC fight in the corpus, so it is not a P2 foundation change).

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 2.1 / Section 5 audit table (resistance mitigation row)

sources_quoted.quote: R_final = max(0, (R - r_flat)*(1 - r_pct/100)*(1 - p) - f)

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 3.1 (definition of the scored quantity)
sources_quoted.quote: `f(S)` = the coupled participant-timeline score: deterministic total damage dealt by the main participant before its own death, summed over the fight window, with an infinitesimal effective-health tiebreak (`score + EHP*1e-9`, optimizer.py `_evaluate_build_uncached`)

independent_computation.scope_limitation: The golden corpus scenario definitions (roster, champions, levels, ranks, fight window, target armor) live under scripts/ and src/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids this investigator from reading. data/ contains no definition of 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' (grep over the whole export returns nothing for the scenario id, 'coupled_scenarios' or 'focus_damage_before_death'). A coupled multi-participant fight score (S7) therefore cannot be reproduced digit-for-digit from data/ alone. What CAN be computed from sources is the admissible band the leaf must fall in, and which single mechanism can move it by exactly the observed amount. That is what follows.

step_1_exact_cesaro_mean.statement: Verified S4's closed form algebraically from the capped ramp.
step_1_exact_cesaro_mean.derivation: mean over k=1..h of min(k,C) = [ sum_{k=1}^{C} k + (h-C)*C ] / h = [ C(C+1)/2 + hC - C^2 ] / h = C + (C - C^2)/(2h) = C - C(C-1)/(2h).  QED for h >= C.
step_1_exact_cesaro_mean.old_model_value: 0.8 * max_stacks = 0.8 * 5 = 4.000 stacks = 24.0% armor reduction (S4). This equals the exact mean only at h = 10 hits; for every longer fight it under-counts, monotonically, toward the 5-stack / 30% cap of S1.
step_1_exact_cesaro_mean.convention_caveat: S4's ramp min(k,C) charges the k-th hit with the stack that hit itself applied. The alternative in-game reading (an instance is not shredded by the stack it applies) gives min(k-1,C) and mean = C - C(C+1)/(2h) = 5 - 15/h, i.e. 0.5 stacks lower at h=30, 0.1 lower at h=50. Both conventions lie strictly inside the same [4, 5] stack band and both exceed the 4.000 constant for h > 15, so this ambiguity does not change the verdict; it only shifts where inside the band the exact answer sits. It is not resolvable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md and is flagged below.

step_2_admissible_band_for_the_leaf.statement: Bound how much the leaf may move when the BC average-reduction model is replaced by the exact Cesaro mean.
step_2_admissible_band_for_the_leaf.model: Physical damage is mitigated by m(R)=100/(100+R) (S5) with R = A*(1 - 0.06*s) after Carve's percentage armor reduction and before/after penetration per S6. Writing P for the armor-mitigated physical share of the old total and (1-P) for magic/true/unmitigated, the leaf scales by  ratio = 1 + P * [ (100 + A*(1-0.24)) / (100 + A*(1-0.06*s_new)) - 1 ].

solved_required_physical_share.note: P must lie in (0, 1]. P > 1 is physically impossible and rules the (A, s_new) pair out.

step_2_admissible_band_for_the_leaf.conclusion: The observed +3.478% is fully inside the band reachable by the exact Cesaro mean of the sourced ramp: it corresponds to an effective stack count of roughly 4.7-5.0 (28-30% armor reduction) against a focus target of ~100-250 armor with a predominantly physical damage share - exactly what 5 - 10/h (or 5 - 15/h) yields for a sustained fight of h >~ 30-50 physical hits, which a Black Cleaver + Bloodsong on-hit build produces. The old value 3226.1 is reachable ONLY at s = 4.000 stacks, i.e. only from the 0.8*max_stacks constant that S4 itself labels 'a documented tuning constant, not a theorem'.

step_3_ruling_out_the_other_named_item.statement: Bloodsong is the other item in the scenario name, so its parameters were tested as alternative causes of the same delta. Under full Expose Weakness uptime (4 s duration vs 1.5 s internal cooldown, S3, so the amp is effectively continuous once the first empowered attack lands), a change of the amp from x to y scales the leaf by (1+y)/(1+x) on the amped share phi:

5% -> 8% (ranged value corrected to mele.reason: phi > 1 is impossible; a full-uptime 5->8 correction can only add 2.857%, less than the observed 3.478%.

0% -> 8%.feasible: only if the amp covered 43% of the damage
0% -> 8%.reason: inconsistent with S3's own uptime arithmetic (4 s window refreshed every 1.5 s => ~full uptime, which would give ~+8%, not +3.5%).

step_3_ruling_out_the_other_named_item.conclusion: No single-parameter Bloodsong correction reproduces +3.478% consistently with its own sourced duration/cooldown. The Black Cleaver stack-model correction does, and it is the change docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.3 explicitly queues ('replace the constant with the closed-form Cesaro mean ... changing it re-tunes every BC fight in the corpus').

step_4_direction_check.statement: Sign test independent of any fitted parameter.
step_4_direction_check.argument: S1 caps Carve at 5 stacks / 30% armor reduction and gives each stack a 6 s life. S4 notes the 6 s stack life exceeds the inter-swing interval for any realistic AS*u > 1/6, so in a sustained fight stacks saturate at the cap and never lapse. Therefore the true Cesaro mean of the ramp is strictly greater than 4.000 stacks for every fight longer than h = 10 hits (5 - 10/h > 4 <=> h > 10), the post-reduction armor R is strictly lower, m(R) = 100/(100+R) (S5) is strictly larger, and the focus damage before death must be strictly HIGHER than the constant model reported. The observed change 3226.1 -> 3338.3 is an increase. Direction matches; the old value is biased low by construction.

verdict_rationale: The old leaf value rests on the fixed 0.8*max_stacks Black Cleaver constant that docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.3 identifies as a tuning constant rather than a theorem, exact only at a 10-hit fight and off by up to ~20% at the extremes. The sourced ramp (Black Cleaver wiki text: 5 stacks, 6% each, 30% cap, 6 s duration) has exact Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/h, which is strictly above 4 stacks for any fight longer than 10 physical hits, hence strictly more armor reduction and strictly more damage through m(R) = 100/(100+R). The observed +3.478% is (a) the right sign, (b) inside the reachable [24% -> 30% reduction] band, requiring an effective ~4.7-5.0 stacks against a ~100-250 armor focus target with a mostly-physical damage share, and (c) not reproducible by any self-consistent single-parameter correction to the other item named in the scenario. New value accepted.
caveats: Not a digit-for-digit reproduction: the scenario definition (roster, levels, ability ranks, fight window, target armor) is outside the permitted evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md), so the coupled fight score of docs Section 3.1 could not be re-simulated. The computation above bounds the leaf and identifies the unique consistent mechanism rather than recomputing the scalar.

Unresolved from sources: whether the k-th shredding hit is mitigated at min(k, 5) stacks (docs Section 2.3's stated engine convention, mean 5 - 10/h) or at min(k-1, 5) stacks (the applying instance not shredding itself, mean 5 - 15/h). The two differ by ~0.5 stacks at h = 30 and ~0.1 stacks at h = 50, i.e. up to ~0.6% on this leaf. Both lie inside the accepted band and both invalidate the old value; recommend the owning change pin this convention explicitly against game files (Community Dragon buff-application ordering), since it is the residual uncertainty on every Black Cleaver leaf.

docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.3 also flags the sibling `hits/2` short-fight branch of the same constant model. If that branch survived the change unchanged, short-fight BC leaves elsewhere in the corpus remain on the tuning constant and should be checked separately.
